subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page: roster overview tiles, kind avatars, and context-usage meters

question: Should the Sessions page redesign in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102523 become the accepted Control UI direction for this issue?
rationale: This is a user-facing feature redesign with a protected maintainer label and an open candidate PR, so automation should not close or replace it before a maintainer decides the product direction.

options.title: Review the linked redesign PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the candidate implementation and close this issue after it merges.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to reduce scope to the specific roster telemetry pieces maintainers want now.

options.title: Reject this UI direction
options.body: Close or retitle the linked PR and leave only a smaller follow-up if a subset remains wanted.

recommendation.title: Review the linked redesign PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the candidate implementation and close this issue after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the issue opener and recent merged feature-history owner for the Sessions page redesign surface.
